title: Hidden Technician
subtitle: Find the paid technician hours that never became billable — and recover them with fixes you approve.
honesty: All figures are estimates built from your job times, valued at {{cost}} per hour (editable in Settings). They are the estimated value of an hour, not guaranteed revenue. Technicians are listed alphabetically; this is not a ranking.

pnl.title: Hours profit & loss by technician
pnl.intro: Paid, billable and leaked hours for the last 28 days. Open a technician to see each day.

how.title: How this is calculated
how.p1: For each technician-day, the paid window starts at the first job and lasts your paid hours per day. Time on billable jobs is billable; everything else in the window is leaked.
how.p2: Every leaked segment gets exactly one cause by fixed rules, so the causes always add up to the leaked total. The Why column shows the rule used.
how.p3: Job statuses and rework flags are measured. Tags and gap-based causes are inferred. Paperwork is an allowance you set, so it is estimated.
how.p4: Overlapping jobs are counted once, overnight jobs stay on the day they started, and rows without usable times are skipped and counted below.
how.p5: Money is hours × {{cost}} — the estimated value of an hour, not revenue you are guaranteed to earn.
how.p6: Recovered hours come only from real later jobs: a booked job worked inside an offered slot, or a drop in that cause versus the 28 days before approval.

quality: Data quality: {{skipped}} jobs skipped for missing or invalid times, {{unassigned}} jobs without an assigned technician.
